name: conduit
description: Agent-first workflow automation for dev teams.

scripts.dev: tsx scripts/preflight.ts dev && turbo run dev
scripts.typecheck: turbo run typecheck && npm run typecheck:test
scripts.db:push: tsx scripts/preflight.ts dev && dotenv -e .env -e .env.local -- npm --workspace @conduit/database run db:push
scripts.db:generate: tsx scripts/preflight.ts dev && dotenv -e .env -e .env.local -- npm --workspace @conduit/database run db:generate
scripts.db:studio: tsx scripts/preflight.ts dev && dotenv -e .env -e .env.local -- npm --workspace @conduit/database run db:studio
scripts.infra:up: tsx scripts/preflight.ts infra && docker compose --env-file .env --env-file .env.local up -d
scripts.test:infra:up: tsx scripts/preflight.ts test-infra && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml --env-file .env --env-file .env.local up -d --wait
